_meta.purpose: Token-level ground truth for the OCR-preprocessing investigation (DECISIONS/0018 amendment). Only item and charge lines are recorded: DECISIONS/0005's keep list. Header, business name, date, phone and tax-registration lines are deliberately absent, exactly as they are absent from the committed replay fixtures.
_meta.status: PROVISIONAL — transcribed from the two photographs by a vision model plus the shipped replay fixtures; the two `obscured` entries are the ones only the owner can settle. Numbers here are not published anywhere until the owner confirms or corrects them.

statuses.printed: legible on the photograph; a variant that reads it differently is wrong
statuses.obscured: partly cut off / faint at the crop edge, so the transcription is a best reading; scored separately and never treated as evidence an adoption improved things
statuses.illegible: not readable by the transcription either; a variant may produce anything and nothing is scored

_meta.scoring: case- and punctuation-insensitive token containment over each image's OCR output; `money: true` tokens are the ones a variant must never lose
